shortDefinition.en: The camera's measurement and interpretation of scene light to inform an exposure proposal or indicator.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 相机测量并解释场景光线，为曝光建议或曝光指示提供信息的过程。

en: A reflected-light meter does not know the intended tone or importance of every subject.
zh-cn: 反射式测光并不知道每个主体应有的影调，也不知道它对拍摄者的重要程度。

example.en: A bright subject occupying much of the frame can influence an automatic exposure proposal, so review the result and compensate deliberately.
example.zh-cn: 占据大部分画面的明亮主体可能影响自动曝光建议，因此要检查结果并有意进行补偿。
